name: Subsurface
blurb: Subsurface is an open source dive logbook for scuba, rebreather, and free divers.
description:
Subsurface is an open source dive logbook for scuba, rebreather, and free divers.
Track your dives by logging locations (with GPS coordinates), gear,
exposure protection used, divemasters and dive buddies, plus your own notes and ratings for each dive.
Subsurface also allows you to plan your dives, by providing a comprehensive dive planner that includes
support for multiple gases, deco planning, and more.

Dives can be downloaded from a variety of dive computers, entered manually, or imported from other
dive log applications.

Features:

• Detailed dive profiles with tank pressure curves and gas analysis

• Calculated SAC rate, partial pressures of O2, N2 and He, and decompression information

• Built-in dive planner

• Printable detailed log books with profiles and notes

• Localized in about 20 languages
